title: Cue code map

nodes.label: cue-cli
nodes.role: Dispatches cue commands to companion binaries and extension executables; packaging owns all four installed names.
nodes.impact: Changes affect command routing and installed distributions.
nodes.testNote: Located test declarations; this map does not claim they were executed.

nodes.label: cue-tui
nodes.role: Owns the terminal workbench, editor, history, request generations and reconnect-safe execution projection.
nodes.impact: Changes affect terminal input, selection, cancellation and rendering.
nodes.testNote: Located test declarations; this map does not claim they were executed.

nodes.label: cue-client
nodes.role: Snapshots explicit Scope, compiles surface input, correlates IPC requests, waits and attaches to PTYs.
nodes.impact: Changes affect all frontends and connection-owned PTY controls.
nodes.testNote: Located test declarations; this map does not claim they were executed.

nodes.label: cue-language
nodes.role: Tokenizes and compiles direct argv syntax into the closed ExecutionSpec; owns assistance and completion.
nodes.impact: Changes affect surface syntax, not daemon execution semantics.
nodes.testNote: Located test declarations; this map does not claim they were executed.

nodes.label: cue-protocol
nodes.role: Defines strict IPC v4 messages, identities and length-prefixed JSON framing.
nodes.impact: Changes affect client/daemon compatibility and persisted command fingerprints.
nodes.testNote: Located test declarations; this map does not claim they were executed.

nodes.label: cue-core
nodes.role: Owns closed plan ADT, Scope, stable Step IDs, facts and pure execution reducer.
nodes.impact: Changes affect every execution, Scope propagation and durable replay.
nodes.testNote: Located test declarations; this map does not claim they were executed.

nodes.label: cue-daemon
nodes.role: Owns local socket and database lifecycle, command idempotency, committed transitions, runtime assembly and attachments.
nodes.impact: Changes affect admission, durability, process ownership and restart recovery.
nodes.testNote: Located test declarations; this map does not claim they were executed.

nodes.label: cue-runtime
nodes.role: Binds typed providers; realizes builtin and captured/PTY leaves; supervises process groups and bounded memory output.
nodes.impact: Changes affect physical process effects, output bytes, cancellation and cleanup.
nodes.testNote: Located test declarations; this map does not claim they were executed.

nodes.label: cue-store-sqlite
nodes.role: Stores Scope, execution projections, facts, operation outcomes and runtime work atomically.
nodes.impact: Changes affect recovery, idempotency, sensitive-value rejection and migration.
nodes.testNote: Located test declarations; this map does not claim they were executed.

nodes.label: SQLite · cued-v4.db
nodes.role: Private WAL database, schema v2: scopes, executions, runtime_work, facts and operations. Output bytes are not persisted.
nodes.impact: Unknown physical Run attempts block recovery; legacy v3 is archived, never imported.
nodes.testNote: Adapter coverage in Cue; no claim of upstream dependency tests.

nodes.label: POSIX processes & PTYs
nodes.role: Unix sockets, file locks, signals, process groups and PTY file descriptors supplied by the host OS through libc/std.
nodes.impact: Platform-specific ownership, permissions, cleanup and peer credentials need real process tests.
nodes.testNote: Adapter coverage in Cue; no claim of upstream dependency tests.

nodes.label: Tokio
nodes.role: Async process, network, I/O, task, synchronization and signal services.
nodes.impact: Scheduling and I/O progress influence daemon and frontend responsiveness.
nodes.testNote: Adapter coverage in Cue; no claim of upstream dependency tests.

nodes.label: Ratatui / Crossterm
nodes.role: Terminal layout, raw input events and terminal lifecycle; used by TUI and client attach.
nodes.impact: Terminal compatibility and input feedback are frontend concerns.
nodes.testNote: Adapter coverage in Cue; no claim of upstream dependency tests.

nodes.label: Serde / BLAKE3 / UUID
nodes.role: Serialization, content hashing and identifier generation; concrete crate dependencies appear in manifests.
nodes.impact: Wire validation, Scope hashes, operation identities and stored JSON depend on these contracts.
nodes.testNote: Adapter coverage in Cue; no claim of upstream dependency tests.

nodes.label: Distribution & agent Skill
nodes.role: Maturin packages Rust executables as cue-run; npm exports the canonical Skill directory, not a JavaScript daemon.
nodes.impact: Package metadata and executable/Skill file allowlists affect installed users.
nodes.testNote: Package smoke scripts are evidence; not executed by map validation.

edges.label: Hello then Scope, execution, output and PTY requests over IPC v4
atomic projection, facts and runtime-work commits
realize ready leaves through typed RuntimeAssembly
spawn pipelines, supervise process groups and pump PTY
known Run completion returns to reducer; output store is shared
responses and replayed/live facts, retained output and PTY data

steps.description: Routes run to the client.
Sends PutScope and compiles the file against its returned hash.
Produces typed Run/Builtin/Sequence/Parallel plans.
Accepts SubmitExecution; commits before scheduling.
Atomically stores operation outcome and execution facts.
Spawns ready pipeline; known completion returns to daemon/reducer.
Waits and prints retained output; no streaming stdin during exec/run.
Loads list and reacts to terminal keys.
Multiplexes queries, commands and events.
Registers watches; commits cancellation and schedules runtime work.
Marks pending work terminal, running work cancelling until completion.
Terminates owned process groups; natural exit may race cancellation.
Applies results/facts to the visible execution projection.
Routes fg to client companion.
Requests attach, forwards input/resize and detaches with Ctrl-].
Enforces one controller plus observers and connection-owned leases.
Pumps PTY output, input and resize with bounded control.
Disconnect releases lease and unfinished input, not the execution.
Detached child acquires socket/database locks and opens private DB.
Migrates schema; rejects recovery of unproven physical Run attempts.
Restores nonterminal projections page by page and drives recoverable work.
Only ready recoverable work is realized; memory output starts empty.
Readiness is Hello from the expected new instance.

limitations: Static source evidence, not runtime or installed-package acceptance.
Dependency edges come from production Cargo manifests; dev-dependencies are excluded.
External dependencies are grouped; Cargo.lock remains the full version inventory.
No remote service or schedule owner exists in the kernel.
Output bytes live in bounded memory and disappear on daemon restart.
